steps.title: Configure Project Environment
steps.description: Initialize package settings, SDK targets (34), and native Java dependencies.

steps.title: Define Application Permissions and Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest with file permissions, themes, and screen declarations.

steps.title: Create Application Resources & Styles
steps.description: Set up material color themes, strings, slide colors, and custom button layouts.

steps.title: Define Database and Admin Schemas
steps.description: Create api_schema.json and admin_setting_schema.json for app backend data.

steps.title: Implement Data Models
steps.description: Create QnAItem model and ConversionRecord model for handling question-answer slides.

steps.title: Implement Backend API Client
steps.description: Build HTTP client for authentication, OTP password reset, data persistence, and admin config caching.

steps.title: Develop OpenXML PPTX Slide Generator Engine
steps.description: Implement native Zip-based OpenXML PPTX exporter to generate playable PowerPoint presentations.

steps.title: Develop Native PDF Renderer & Q&A Parser
steps.description: Implement PdfRenderer helper for rendering PDF documents and extracting structured Q&A text.

steps.title: Create User Authentication UI
steps.description: Build Login, Registration, and Forgot Password OTP screens.

steps.title: Create Main Dashboard View & Layout
steps.description: Design dashboard with PDF upload card, text editor trigger, slide stats, and conversion history.

steps.title: Create PDF Picker and Visual Extractor
steps.description: Build PDF document loader, page navigator, and automatic question-answer detection view.

steps.title: Create Interactive Q&A Editor
steps.description: Design card-based slide editor for modifying questions, answers, and visual slide properties.

steps.title: Build Presentation Slide Previewer
steps.description: Implement real-time visual slide deck viewer with slide counter, theme toggles, and answer reveal effects.

steps.title: Integrate Native PPT File Export & Sharing
steps.description: Connect PowerPoint generator to Android file provider and system intent sharer.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility & Local Calculations
steps.description: Ensure offline slide deck count calculation and zero external third-party library dependencies.

steps.title: Building Q&A PDF to PPT Converter
steps.description: Compile final debug APK with assembleDebug and verify OpenXML PowerPoint generation.
